text:
ives: FYI — morning key rewrap + a permissions tidy caused SAST/DAST to fail across multiple PRs. scanner hits KMS.Decrypt denied and DAST hit proxy 502s. cc @sre-oncall

meera: i gated the keyring principals while cleaning up old service accounts at 10:02 UTC and may have removed svc-scanner from the cryptoKeyDecrypter role. investigating; will not widen grants without a temp condition.

ops-bot: alert: scan-failure-rate increased from 3% -> 68% between 10:03-10:10. Auto-creation of tickets paused to avoid noise.

ives: can we do a short-lived conditional grant and run a smoke matrix, capture raw bundles to GS, then revoke? want audit id in the thread.

meera: plan: (1) add 30m conditional binding for svc-scanner, (2) open proxy allowlist for scanner egress to internal staging for 30m, (3) re-run failing jobs with evidence persist step, (4) tag issues with `scan:rotation-incident`. I'll post the gcloud command and audit id when applied.

meera: applying binding now:
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/prod-llm-key \\
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter \\
  --condition='expression=request.time < timestamp("2026-03-23T10:35:00Z"),title=tmp_scanner_decrypt'
```

meera: audit entry id (redacted): AUD-7X4Y5Z at 10:12 UTC. proxy allowlist opened for 10:12-10:45.

ives: adding this GH step to ensure artifacts persist even if decrypt fails:
```
- name: Persist scanner bundle on failure
  run: |
    tar -czf raw-bundle-${{ github.run_id }}.tgz scanner-output || true
    gsutil cp raw-bundle-${{ github.run_id }}.tgz gs://vuln-evidence/${{ github.run_id }}/ || true
```

sre-oncall: muting scan noise for 45m while re-runs happen. monitoring backlog and page SLOs. :white_check_mark: 

triage-bot: created SEC-7700 "Scans aborted after keyring tidy" tags: [scan:rotation-incident] assigned @ives

meera: follow-ups: remove temporary IAM binding and proxy allowlist after re-runs (due in 30m), land artifact-persist step in pipeline (EOD), and add a pre-rotation checklist item: verify scanner SA has cryptoKeyDecrypter on target keyring and smoke-run scans.

ives: root cause candidate: keyring principal cleanup removed scanner decryption permission + no artifact persistence step. closing loop after re-runs and short postmortem. :memo:
